fresh_leads.title: Software Engineering Intern, UX/UI 2027
fresh_leads.qualification_text: What We're Looking For - Currently pursuing a degree in UX/UI Design, Human-Computer Interaction, Interaction Design, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field. - Coursework, project, or internship experience in UI/UX design, interaction design, product design, or front-end/mobile development. - A portfolio or examples of work demonstrating your approach to solving user problems through design. This can include class projects, personal projects, apps, prototypes, or previous internships. - Familiarity with design and prototyping tools such as Figma or similar software. - An interest in designing interfaces for technical, real-time, or complex systems. - Strong attention to detail and an instinct for creating simple, intuitive user experiences. - Curiosity about how software is built and a willingness to work closely with engineers. - Basic understanding of software development concepts and how UI connects to application logic. - A builder's mindset: you'd rather create something, get feedback, and iterate than wait for a perfect spec. - Strong communication skills and the ability to explain the thinking behind your design decisions. You'll Stand Out - Experience designing interfaces for mobile, tablet, embedded, or real-time applications. - Experience with Android, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin, or other mobile development technologies. - Experience creating interactive prototypes or working with production design systems. - Experience designing for game-like interactions, simulations, controllers, or other non-traditional input methods. - Familiarity with accessibility, responsive design, and usability principles. - Experience collaborating directly with software engineers to implement designs. - Coursework or project experience in human-computer interaction, computer science, or interaction design. - Interest in embedded systems, robotics, autonomy, or other technically complex products. Why ACS - Direct impact: Your work contributes to products that are built for real-world use — not stuck in a slide deck. - Real ownership: You'll work directly with the engineers and product team building Bullfrog and contribute to real product decisions from day one. - Small team, big scope: At a startup this size, interns take on meaningful problems and see their work move from concept to implementation. - Cross-functional experience: Work alongside designers, product managers, and engineers to understand what it takes to build and ship a product. - Mentorship: Learn from experienced engineers and product builders who have designed and fielded real defense systems.

fresh_leads.title: Software Engineer
fresh_leads.qualification_text: Software Engineer South San Francisco, California Color is revolutionizing cancer care with the nation's first Virtual Cancer Clinic, delivering high-quality, physician-led multidisciplinary care across all 50 states. Our innovative, guideline-based approach spans cancer screening, risk assessment, prevention, diagnosis, treatment support, and survivorship. In addition to personalized direct medical care, our services include cancer genetics risk assessment, nutrition, mental health support and at-home cancer screening diagnostics. Using technology-driven, patient-centric solutions, Color is transforming how employers, unions, health plans, and governments address cancer. Color's goal is to close critical cancer care gaps, improve cancer outcomes, and guide patients with empathy through their healthcare journeys. Apply to join Color and do the most meaningful work of your career. If you are not sure that you're 100% qualified but are up for the challenge - we want you to apply! Role Introduction: We are excited to bring a cohort of recent software engineering graduates to our technical team of roughly 50 engineers, product managers and designers. These two engineers will join teams who are working on the AI platform that will power internal care team tools and patient experiences, and the services and experiences that enable our patients to efficiently onboard, assess risk and get the appropriate screenings. This new grad cohort (four in total) will be onboarded to Color's systems and thoughtfully supported by senior engineers and leads as they learn the craft of software engineering. The engineering and product team will help you build skills in engineering design, code review best practices, testing best practices, observability best practices and collaboration skills with product & engineering peers. Sample projects the cohort will contribute to: - Embed AI-driven automation into care workflows to significantly increase care team capacity without sacrificing quality - Extend and build patient experiences across their entire journey – from onboarding & enrollment, testing & resulting, in treatment experiences to survivorship - Build infrastructure for developers to expand and unlock developer efficiencies and enable new AI tooling Our Ideal Candidate Will Have: - Graduated in 2025 or 2026 with a four year degree in Computer Science - A passion for using software and technology to help save lives and prevent catastrophic disease, and want to apply your skills in the service of a greater mission - A commitment to producing high quality code, and helping to eliminate unnecessary duplication and awkward workarounds - Experience using AI tools (e.g., code generation, copilot) in development workflows. - Curiosity around intentionally applying ML/AI to real-world problems - Motivation to join a team with rigorous engineering practices and discipline: code reviews, automated testing, logging, monitoring, alerting, etc - Familiarity with web development and with modern web stacks including Python, Django, AWS, SQL, REST APIs, React, HTML5, CSS3, and ES6+ - An affinity for collaborating with technical and non-technical colleagues; values incorporating feedback to make decisions using code reviews, docs, wikis, meetings, and other channels as needed Helpful Though Not Required: - Experience building with or integrating LLM-powered features is a plus. What We Offer: - 💰 Competitive salary - ✨ Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life, and disability
